title: Stay Hydrated
summary: Drink enough water throughout the day to support your body.
content: Regular fluid intake helps your body maintain normal functions and supports hydration throughout the day.

title: Build a Balanced Plate
summary: Include a variety of vegetables, fruits, whole grains and protein foods.
content: A varied diet can include vegetables, fruits, legumes, whole grains and appropriate sources of protein.

title: Sleep Well, Live Well
summary: Aim for a consistent sleep routine and enough rest each night.
content: Good sleep is an important part of overall wellbeing. A consistent sleep schedule can help support healthy sleep habits.

title: Move Your Body
summary: Regular physical activity can support your overall health and wellbeing.
content: Regular movement and physical activity can contribute to physical and mental wellbeing.

title: Take Care of Your Mind
summary: Make time for rest, connection and activities that help you recharge.
content: Looking after your mental wellbeing can include maintaining social connections, getting enough rest and making time for activities you enjoy.

title: Choose More Whole Foods
summary: Include minimally processed foods as part of a varied diet.
content: Vegetables, fruits, legumes and whole grains can form important parts of a varied and balanced diet.

title: Make Movement a Habit
summary: Find simple opportunities to move throughout your day.
content: Walking, stretching and other forms of physical activity can help you incorporate more movement into your daily routine.

title: Create a Calm Evening
summary: Give yourself time to slow down before going to bed.
content: A relaxing evening routine can help you prepare for sleep and make your bedtime more consistent.
